name: Arugal Must Die
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 8,850 experience instead of 3,300, 2.68 times as much. Read from what the game server sent in the beta. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Arugal still resides in Shadowfang Keep. We cannot claim Silverpine as a strategic stronghold for the Dark Lady until Arugal is slain.

I shall see to it that his magic is eradicated, adventurer. But I leave it in your hands to see that Arugal meets the death he so deserves.

Travel to Shadowfang Keep and put an end to Arugal's foul spells once and for all. Bring to me the vile wizard's head!
narrative.objectives: Kill Arugal and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
narrative.offerRewardText: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, adventurer. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
narrative.requestItemsText: With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.
